meta.title: 自用综艺感vlog音效分享！
meta.title_en: My Go-To Variety-Show Vlog Sound Effects!
meta.topic: 视频剪辑 · 综艺音效

scenes.context: 想让vlog生动有趣，少不了要拿音效当佐料。常用的音效可以分为这几类：表示尴尬或者用于衔接的。语域：剪辑教学，概念引入。
sentences: 音效，是让vlog生动的佐料。
Sound effects are the seasoning for a lively vlog.
the seasoning（佐料）
常用的音效，可以分为几类。
Common effects fall into a few categories.
fall into categories（分类）
比如表示尴尬的、用于衔接的。
Like the awkward ones and the transition ones.
the awkward ones（尴尬类）
paraphrase: 佐料 → the seasoning / the flavor
scenes.speak: Sound effects are the seasoning for a lively vlog. Common effects fall into a few categories. Like the awkward ones and the transition ones.

scenes.context: 表示停顿或制造反差感的，还有用于衔接转场的。以上都只是大概意思，好玩的是可以根据画面发挥想象力。语域：剪辑教学，分类讲解。
sentences: 有表示停顿、制造反差感的。
Some mark pauses and create contrast.
create contrast（制造反差）
还有用于衔接转场的。
Others bridge the transitions.
bridge the transitions（衔接转场）
分类只是大概，发挥想象力才好玩。
Categories are rough — imagination makes it fun.
imagination makes it fun（发挥想象力）
paraphrase: 发挥想象力 → use your imagination / get creative
scenes.speak: Some mark pauses and create contrast. Others bridge the transitions. Categories are rough — imagination makes it fun.

scenes.context: 举个例子，按照想要的感觉，联想到其他元素，可能收获不一样的效果。听起来脆脆的，不大概才有意思。语域：剪辑教学，举例收尾。
sentences: 按想要的感觉，联想其他元素。
Match the mood by associating other elements.
associating elements（联想元素）
可能收获不一样的效果。
You may get a completely different effect.
a different effect（不一样的效果）
听起来脆脆的，才有意思。
Something crispy-sounding is way more fun.
crispy-sounding（脆脆的）
paraphrase: 脆脆的 → crispy-sounding / a crisp pop
scenes.speak: Match the mood by associating other elements. You may get a completely different effect. Something crispy-sounding is way more fun.

practice: Sound effects are the seasoning for a lively vlog.
Some mark pauses and create contrast.
Match the mood by associating other elements.
pitfalls: Sound effects are the seasoning for a lively vlog.
Some mark pauses and create contrast.
Match the mood by associating other elements.
「发挥想象力」用 associating elements / imagination。
Something crispy-sounding is way more fun.
shifts: 用 the seasoning（佐料）、the awkward ones（尴尬类）、crispy-sounding（脆脆的）
用 bridge the transitions（衔接转场）、create contrast（制造反差）、mark pauses（标记停顿）
用 associating elements（联想元素）、imagination makes it fun（想象力）、free-associate（自由联想）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：夹仔→尴尬、弦接→衔接、挺顿→停顿、反差感、佐料、脆脆的、不大概才有意思→不大怪才有意思等。
